verdict.rationale: ClickHouse documents an isolated local environment kept separate from production. clickhousectl can install local ClickHouse versions and launch and manage local servers, then push local development to cloud. The install docs say to run it on your own machine to build, test, and experiment, and clickhouse-local and chDB offer lightweight in-process testing without a full server. Missing for 10: a cloud-side sandbox or branch/clone of production data for realistic testing, agent-specific guardrails (e.g. a read-only MCP mode) tying the sandbox to AI workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration of the local-to-cloud workflow.
